title: Missing or unreopenable borg.txt can leave configuration or file pointers NULL

impact.description: Retained source report; practical reachability, actual outcome and port applicability require independent review.

reported_sources.text:
`borg_init_txt_file()`: if borg.txt is missing and cannot be written, it
  returns before `borg_cfg` is allocated; `borg_init()` then reads the NULL
  `borg_cfg` and crashes. If the written file cannot be reopened,
  `file_getl()` reads through a NULL file.
